title: Do you guys struggle with this?
author: PristineImplement201
selftext: Hey everyone! I recently got into Ai/ML and was working on a project that I needed to train CV models with. I used google colab a bunch but kept running into issues - setting up environment, Dataset took a while to upload to google drive (Fine tuning) and even the free version with the T40 gpu constantly lagged.. I built a tool that's basically a local ai trainer with zero CLI, and the possibility of connecting to cloud gpus for scale. Im wondering, is this something useful for the public, or am i delusional :/
